name: digipen_module_profile
description: Compliance rules for DigiPen/SIT module profile documents (syllabi). Based on CSD3150, CSD3151, CSD2101 sample documents.
rules: The document must include a module code (e.g. CSD3150) and module title.
The document must state the number of credit units or SIT credits assigned to the module.
The document must list at least one module lead or coordinator with their email address.
The document must include a module descriptor or description that summarises what the module covers.
The document must list at least two numbered learning outcomes using action verbs (e.g. Demonstrate, Implement, Analyse).
The document must include a detailed assessment breakdown where all weightings sum to 100%.
The document must state a pass grade requirement (e.g. 'D grade or above to pass').
The document must include a late submission policy that specifies grade penalties or deadlines.
The document must include an academic integrity or plagiarism policy.
The document must state a policy on the use of AI or LLM tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Copilot).
The document must include disability support or accessibility information with a contact point.
The document must state the last day or week to withdraw from the module.
The document must include an attendance policy specifying consequences for absences.
The document must provide a weekly schedule or list of topics covered across the trimester.
The document must specify the total study hours or workload breakdown by activity type (e.g. lecture, assignment, self-study).
